title: Host Hook Protocol v1 dialect capability declaration

can_block_tool.description: The agent documents a way for a hook to stop a tool before it runs. A declaration, not a verification.

can_ask.description: The agent documents an 'ask the user' output for tool.before.

inject_events.description: Events whose native hook output the agent documents as reaching the model. With inject_mode 'deferred' these are the events the runtime delivers a held pack on, not the events that produced it.

inject_mode.description: direct: the pack is returned on the event that produced it. deferred: the agent cannot take context there, so the runtime holds the pack per session and delivers it once on the next inject_events event (ADR 0018).
